summary: Platform Engineer with over a decade of experience building internal platforms, automation, and infrastructure for engineering teams in fintech, retail commerce, security, and defense.

experience.title: Platform Developer
highlights: Led the company-wide LaunchDarkly feature-flag integration: designed the architecture with internal and vendor architects, built a CI/CD module that generates flags from YAML, defined the permissions model, and wrote onboarding and architecture documentation so 700+ developers could manage feature flags independently and safely.

Owned an internal NuGet automation system that updates packages through pull requests and blocks releases with outdated dependencies, processing 14K+ runs per day to enforce compliance and protect production stability.
Documented the dependency automation architecture in a component map adopted by DevOps, helping standardize understanding of a mission-critical internal service.
Worked in a distributed microservices environment using .NET service templates, Kafka and RabbitMQ for messaging, and MongoDB and SQL Server for data storage.
Stepped in as interim Scrum Master when needed to keep team delivery moving.

experience.title: Platform Developer & DevOps
highlights: Led development of internal .NET automation tools that streamlined development, testing, and deployment, reducing release time by 50%.
Managed and expanded development infrastructure across Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, and GitHub Actions.
Helped define infrastructure standards and delivery workflows through shared tooling used by development teams.
Designed a core adapter that enabled external client UIs to integrate cleanly with the platform.

experience.title: Software Developer
highlights: Built and published a cross-platform Web API service to Azure from scratch, enabling control of a smart electronic security system and contributing to roughly a 10% increase in product orders, about 100 additional units.
Developed and maintained a Representational State Transfer (REST) API handling customer requests from web and mobile applications.
Built a REST API that triggered SMS notifications to customers through a third-party API.
Worked hands-on with C++, C#, Node.js, and Azure.

experience.title: Software Developer
highlights: Developed on a highly complex, distributed server-side system.
Worked with C#, PL/SQL, Linux, and Oracle databases.

experience.title: Software Developer
highlights: Developed configuration-management software for a platform controlling and monitoring multiple sensors and electro-optical systems, owning the software lifecycle from requirements through deployment and maintenance.
Reduced product complexity by building file-manager software that simplified system configuration.

Built client and server software with C++ using object-oriented programming (OOP), Standard Template Library (STL), Microsoft Foundation Class (MFC), XML, design patterns, and multithreaded development in a near-real-time environment, including serial communication (RS232) and ActiveX.

sideProjects.name: NextRole
sideProjects.description: An end-to-end job-search platform — discovers roles and scores CV-to-role fit at ingest time via a two-stage AI pipeline (fast triage, then deep evaluation), generates AI-tailored résumés per application, and auto-updates status via a Gmail-integrated worker. Built on .NET, Python, MongoDB, and React; containerized with Docker, deployed on Render.

strengths: Owning data reliability end to end
